description: Defines an abstract class ConnectionIssue for representing and tracking connection problems within log consistency protocols in Orleans. Includes properties for timestamps, failure counts, retry delays, and an abstract method for computing retry delays.

classes.name: ConnectionIssue
classes.description: An abstract class encapsulating information about connection problems encountered during log consistency operations, including timestamps, failure counts, retry delays, and an abstract method to calculate retry delays.

methods.name: ComputeRetryDelay
methods.description: Abstract method to compute the delay before next retry based on previous delay.
